europe_pmc.coverage: Biomedical literature, including PubMed and additional scholarly sources

openalex.coverage: Cross-disciplinary scholarly works and research graph

focus_areas.name: Cancer drug response and resistance
priority_questions: Which response signals generalize across cohorts, institutions, and assays?
Which mechanisms distinguish sensitivity from acquired or intrinsic resistance?
Which computational predictions could change a treatment or experimental decision?

focus_areas.name: Single-cell and spatial treatment response
priority_questions: How do pre-existing cell states or spatial niches shape response?
Which treatment-induced transitions are reproducible across patients?
Can tissue context improve prediction beyond composition and clinical covariates?

focus_areas.name: Multimodal precision medicine
priority_questions: When does an additional modality add decision value rather than redundancy?
Which biomarkers remain calibrated under population and site shift?
How can molecular predictions be validated for a defined clinical use?

focus_areas.name: Perturbation models and virtual cells
priority_questions: Which perturbation effects are identifiable from available observations?
Can models extrapolate to unseen drugs, doses, combinations, or cell contexts?
What prospective experiment would falsify the claimed counterfactual ability?
